title: 数一数，一到十
subtitle: 每个数字，都有它的样子
character: wearing a red sweater, dark blue trousers and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration drawn with coloured chalk on a dark green blackboard, soft chalky lines with visible chalk dust, bright white, yellow and pink chalk, flat and simple

pages.zh:
今天我学会了一件事——
我会数数了！
从一数到十，
一个都不会漏。
你也跟我一起数，好不好？
pages.scene: The little boy stands in front of a big dark green blackboard in a classroom, holding a piece of white chalk, smiling proudly.

pages.zh:
一。
天上只有一个太阳，
圆圆的，暖暖的。
它每天早上升起来，
照亮一整个世界。
pages.scene: One big round sun drawn in yellow chalk in the middle of a dark green blackboard, with a large white chalk number 1 beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
二。
我有两只眼睛，
可以看见你；
还有两只耳朵，
可以听见你说话。
pages.scene: Two simple chalk-drawn eyes side by side on a dark green blackboard, with a large white chalk number 2 beside them. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
三。
小三轮车有三个轮子，
一个在前面，
两个在后面，
骑起来稳稳当当。
pages.scene: A simple tricycle drawn in white and pink chalk on a dark green blackboard, its three wheels clearly visible, with a large white chalk number 3 beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
四。
小狗有四条腿，
跑起来嗒嗒嗒。
桌子也有四条腿，
站着一动不动。
pages.scene: A simple dog with four legs drawn in white chalk on a dark green blackboard, with a large white chalk number 4 beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
五。
张开一只手，
数一数：
一、二、三、四、五。
刚好五个手指头。
pages.scene: One open hand with five fingers spread, drawn in white chalk on a dark green blackboard, with a large white chalk number 5 beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
六。
盒子里有六个鸡蛋，
两个一排，
三排刚刚好。
数一数，一个也不少。
pages.scene: Six simple oval eggs drawn in white chalk on a dark green blackboard, arranged in three rows of two, with a large white chalk number 6 beside them. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
七。
雨后的天上挂着彩虹，
红、橙、黄、绿、
蓝、靛、紫——
数一数，一共七种颜色。
pages.scene: A rainbow arc drawn in seven coloured chalk stripes on a dark green blackboard, with a large white chalk number 7 beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
八。
章鱼有八条腕足，
软软的，弯弯的，
在水里一摆一摆。
数一数，真的是八条。
pages.scene: A simple octopus with eight arms drawn in pink chalk on a dark green blackboard, with a large white chalk number 8 beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
九。
晚上的天空，
我数到了九颗星星。
有的亮一点，
有的暗一点，一闪一闪的。
pages.scene: Nine simple five-pointed stars drawn in yellow chalk scattered on a dark green blackboard, with a large white chalk number 9 beside them. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
十。
脱下袜子，
数数我的脚趾头：
左脚五个，右脚五个，
合起来正好是十。
pages.scene: Two simple bare feet drawn in white chalk on a dark green blackboard, five toes on each foot, with a large white chalk number 10 beside them. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
一、二、三、四、五，
六、七、八、九、十。
我数到十啦！
「数一数」身边的东西，
到处都藏着数字呢。
pages.scene: The little boy stands in front of the dark green blackboard with both arms raised, laughing, chalk numbers and small drawings covering the board behind him.
